description: Calibration-only one-failure manifest for the 00ca01c4 certified exact window. The victim and immutable backup DP are taken from the frozen solver plan; this is not a formal primary cell.

deployment.simulator_boundary: pp_rank identifies the failed stage while the containing DP replica is unavailable during replacement

separation_note: The 0.01 policy prior is an optimizer input and is not inferred from this realized one-event calibration manifest.
admission_safety_boundary: The 4.9 s injection lies after p1-m3 completion and inside p1-m4 in both calibrated online and offline timelines. The no-failure exact calibration places p1-m4 on DP2 with backup DP3; no request uses DP0 as execution or backup during this short outage. This gate therefore tests the same request-completion retry poll in both clocks without claiming the bootstrap MILP models admission during an unavailable backup interval.
